name: superfocus
description: Plan your day, review your week, capture tasks and check in on goals with your Superfocus season, goals, tasks and calendar.

interface.longDescription: Superfocus keeps your season, goals, milestones, tasks and calendar in one place. With this plugin you can plan your day with fewer, longer blocks, run a weekly review that compares hours per goal with your intent, turn pasted notes into tasks mapped to your goals, and check progress on each goal. Reading is always available. Changes to your calendar, tasks and goals only happen if you allow edits when you connect, and you are asked to confirm before anything is written.
defaultPrompt: Turn these notes into tasks for my goals
